title: Company list deduplication
brief: Each line is a company name. Remove duplicates: two lines are the same company if they match after ignoring letter case, punctuation, extra spaces and one trailing legal suffix (Inc, LLC, Ltd, GmbH, Corp). Keep the first spelling seen, exactly as written. Return one company per line, in the order first seen.
limitation: Checks name-level duplicates on short synthetic lists: case, punctuation and common legal suffixes. Not fuzzy matching, typos, parent and subsidiary links, or matching by domain.

cases.input:
Acme Inc.
Northwind Traders {{nonce}}
ACME, inc
Blue Harbor LLC
northwind traders {{nonce}} ltd
Blue Harbor
cases.revision: Now sort the companies alphabetically, ignoring case.

cases.input:
Zenith Labs GmbH
Orbit {{nonce}} Corp
Zenith Labs
Harbor Point Ltd
orbit {{nonce}}
Harbor Point, Ltd.
cases.expected:
Zenith Labs GmbH
Orbit {{nonce}} Corp
Harbor Point Ltd
cases.revision: Now list them in reverse order, so the last one first seen comes first.
cases.revisionExpected:
Harbor Point Ltd
Orbit {{nonce}} Corp
Zenith Labs GmbH

title: Job title seniority
brief: The input is CSV with columns id,title. Add a column seniority with exactly one of: C-level, VP, Director, Manager, Individual contributor. C-level: a Chief … Officer title or CEO, CFO, CTO, COO, CMO, CRO. VP: Vice President, VP, SVP or EVP. Director: Director or Head of. Manager: Manager or Lead. Anything else: Individual contributor. Keep the rows in order and return CSV with the header id,title,seniority.
limitation: Checks a fixed five-level mapping on clear-cut synthetic titles. Not ambiguous titles, titles in other languages, or whether a contact really makes buying decisions.

title: Country codes from country names
brief: The input is CSV with columns id,country, where the country is written in many ways (English, local names, abbreviations). Add a column iso2 with the country's ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code in capitals. Keep the rows and the country text as given, and return CSV with the header id,country,iso2.
limitation: Checks country-name variants mapped to ISO codes on ten synthetic rows. Not addresses, regions or cities, disputed or ambiguous names, or any other enrichment.

title: Domains from URLs and emails
brief: Each line is a URL or an email address. Return the host name of each in lowercase: no protocol, no leading www., no port, path or query, and for an email or mailto: link only the part after @. Remove duplicate host names, keeping the first. One host name per line, in the order first seen.
limitation: Checks host names taken from tidy synthetic URLs and emails. Not crawling, following links or redirects, or public-suffix edge cases beyond .co.uk.

cases.revision: Return only the registrable domain: drop subdomains such as blog., but keep two-part endings like .co.uk whole.
